titleStmt.title: Deterministic Extraction of Scholarly Full Text

div.p: We describe an idempotent pipeline stage that turns fetched PDF assets into durable text artifacts without depending on any remote service.

div.head: Introduction
div.p: The baseline path uses a pure-Python text layer reader. The optional path posts the same bytes to a local GROBID instance and stores the returned TEI verbatim.

div.head: Method
div.p: Products compete under a total order so that the terminal database state is a function of the input set rather than of arrival order.
